title: Amazon Polly delivers a major upgrade to its Generative engine
summary: The Amazon Polly Generative engine gets a major upgrade: more expressive, more accurate speech with low latency, plus 14 new voices across 9 locales and general availability of Hindi and Finnish. This drop-in upgrade requires no code changes and is now generally available in prod
reason: AWS official blog, but the upgrade adds expressiveness, voices, and locales; no observed N.0/major-version label or defined new capability (modality/tool use/context length), so model-releases is unmet and no other rule covers it.
